BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transportation funding; adding a new section tochapter 46.16 RCW; creating a new section; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to all other license fees, passenger cars, traveltrailers, and motor homes shall pay an annual roadway improvement feeof one and onehalf cents per vehicle pound based on the vehicle curbweight. In addition, vehicles licensed under RCW 46.16.070 weighingless than ten thousand pounds shall pay an annual roadway improvementfee of one and onehalf cents per pound based on the vehicle curbweight. (2) The department shall collect the fee annually at the time oflicense renewal. The department shall rely on vehicle curb weights asprovided by vehicle manufacturers to determine the weight of eachvehicle type. The department shall adopt rules to handle vehicleswithout manufacturer curb weights, such as homebuilt vehicles. p. 1 HB 2975 (3) The fee collected under this section must be deposited into themotor vehicle account. Twothirds of the revenue will be used by thestate exclusively for highway improvement projects. The remainder willbe divided equally between counties and cities and distributed monthlyto counties and cities by the state treasurer. A particular county'sdistribution will be based on the number of vehicles registered in thatcounty as a percentage of the state's total registrations, and aparticular city's distribution will be based on its population as apercentage of the state's total population living within incorporatedareas.
This act applies to license renewalsoccurring on or after January 1, 2005.
